description: A close view of a huge, shaggy creature with two heads side by side on one massive body, seen from the party's eye level and filling the picture. Both heads have pink-red skin, flat pig-like snouts, pointed ears, heavy wrinkled brows and thick brown manes; the right head also has a curved horn. Their mouths are full of jagged white teeth. Below them the body is covered in coarse brown and purple fur, and near the bottom two curved, silvery blades or claws gleam. The background is a flat cyan sky. The colors are hot and earthy, and the mood is savage and noisy. Frame 1: the left head roars with jaws wide while the right head snarls, briefly. Frame 2: the left head shifts its open jaw and the claws move, held a little longer. Frame 3: the right head starts to open its mouth, briefly. Frame 4: the right head tilts down and gapes wider, held a little longer. The loop reads as the two heads taking turns bellowing in a quick, alternating rhythm.
title: Two-headed brute roaring
